question: Which Trika scriptures belong to the first half and how were they named?
premises: Certain Trika scriptures belong to the first half of this lineage.
Those scriptures are known by the name Ṣaḍardha.
The teachers have clearly spoken of them as such.
inference: The Trika scriptures of the first half are identified by the teachers as the Ṣaḍardha scriptures.
plain_english: Those Trika scriptures that belong to the first half of this lineage are the ones the teachers have clearly spoken of under the name Ṣaḍardha.
